text:
Connor O'Brien: Heads up: we’re lining up the SDK + docs releases for the streaming/tools/structured outputs example refresh. Dropping a checklist here so we don’t miss version bumps/changelogs/timing. Goal is “docs live” + “SDK patch versions out” within the same day.

Connor O'Brien: Proposed release window: Wed 10:00–14:00 PT. Please reply with your repo status + target version.

ReleaseBot: :clipboard: Reminder set by Connor O'Brien — "SDK+docs examples refresh release checklist" (due in 2 hours)

Ibrahim Khan: +1. Canonical event model doc is finalized; SDKs should match.

Monica Patel: We need to keep this as patch releases (no breaking changes). Also want explicit version requirements in docs if any behavior needs min SDK.

Connor O'Brien: Checklist draft:
1) Merge readiness
- [ ] SDK PRs approved + green CI (incl snippet tests)
- [ ] Docs PRs approved + green CI
- [ ] redwood-examples PRs merged + CI runner green

2) Versioning
- [ ] Python: bump patch, publish to PyPI
- [ ] TypeScript: bump patch, publish to npm
- [ ] Go: tag module version (patch) + update examples references

3) Changelog/release notes
- [ ] Each SDK: short changelog entry: “Updated streaming/tool calling/structured output examples; clarified event semantics; added troubleshooting links”
- [ ] Docs: changelog entry + “migration note: tool calling terminology + partial args handling”

4) Timing/order (important)
- [ ] Merge redwood-examples first (so docs/SDK can link to canonical paths)
- [ ] Merge docs PR(s) next (deploy)
- [ ] Then cut SDK releases within ~1–2h of docs deploy

5) Go/no-go
- [ ] Smoke test: run each canonical snippet once against staging (rate-limit safe)
- [ ] Confirm gateway behavior for tool_call deltas matches docs wording

Connor O'Brien: Anything missing? Also: who owns the docs deploy push button this week?

Elliot Price: I can take docs deploy coordination. We have PRs 901-904 queued; I want final copy review on the troubleshooting callouts before merge.

Wei Chen: Hosted API docs side: streaming page references new event names. Need to ensure we don’t mention “function calling” anywhere in headings; PM wanted “tool calling” consistently.

Dana Lo: TS SDK PRs 322-325 are ready. Version target: `redwood@1.18.4` (patch). Only thing left is confirming the AbortSignal example doesn’t conflict with our older node fetch docs.

Mateusz Zielinski: Go PRs 211-213 ready. Planning tag `v0.9.3`. One note: context timeout default guidance—docs should say “set explicit deadline” and mention proxy buffering.

Sahana Iyer: Snippet runner in redwood-examples is green on mock; staging run is gated behind `RUN_STAGING=1`. For release day I can trigger staging job manually and paste results here.

Sabrina James: redwood-examples PR 145-147: last review comments addressed; just waiting on Monica’s approval for the tool allowlist wording.

Monica Patel: I’ll review within the hour. Re tool calling safety: please keep examples strictly allowlisted and no “shell out” patterns.

Connor O'Brien: Re order: I’d like to merge examples repo first thing Wed AM, then docs. SDKs can ship once docs deploy is confirmed.

Elliot Price: Works. For docs we also need to align nav/IA (PR 904). That’s low risk but if it gets contentious we can ship content first and nav second.

Ibrahim Khan: Prefer shipping nav with content so users can find it, but I’m ok splitting if it blocks.

Connor O'Brien: Let’s decide now:
- Option A: Content + nav together (single docs deploy)
- Option B: Content deploy, then nav later same day

Dana Lo: A unless 904 has surprises.

Mateusz Zielinski: A.

Wei Chen: A.

Elliot Price: A. I’ll keep 904 small and we can revert quickly if needed.

Connor O'Brien: Great. Version list (please confirm):
- Python SDK: ?
- TS SDK: 1.18.4
- Go SDK: v0.9.3
- Docs: deploy from `main` after PRs merged

Monica Patel: Python will be `0.27.2` (patch). Ibrahim/Sabrina are finalizing the tool-call aggregation tests; should be ready by Tuesday EOD.

Ibrahim Khan: Confirmed: python patch `0.27.2`. Also adding a “partial tool args” note + better exception message when tool args aren’t valid JSON yet.

Connor O'Brien: Nice. Changelog snippets — please keep them consistent. Suggested template:
“Docs/examples refresh: streaming event iteration updated; tool call deltas clarified; structured output schema validation + retry guidance. No API behavior changes.”

Dana Lo: TS changelog ok. I’ll add a line: “Parallel tools example now aggregates args across deltas.”

Mateusz Zielinski: Go changelog ok. I’ll mention context cancellation + deadline example.

Elliot Price: Docs changelog: I’ll add a short entry in site changelog + add an “Upgrading from older snippets” callout on each page.

Sahana Iyer: FYI staging smoke plan:
- 1 run per language per pattern (streaming, tools, structured)
- max tokens low
- `REDWOOD_API_KEY_STAGING` in GH secrets
- concurrency 1 to avoid rate limits

Connor O'Brien: Love it. On release day, please post:
- docs deploy SHA
- SDK release links
- any known caveats

Connor O'Brien: Timing proposal (Wed PT):
10:00 merge redwood-examples
10:30 trigger staging snippet runs
11:15 merge docs PRs + deploy
12:00 cut SDK releases (PyPI/npm/go tags)
13:00 post announcement in #devex + update internal release brief

Monica Patel: Works. One ask: please ensure docs mention minimum SDK versions if applicable (e.g., TS tool delta helpers introduced recently). Don’t want support tickets from copy/paste on older versions.

Dana Lo: TS min version should be 1.18.0 for the new stream iterator type. I’ll confirm and tell Elliot.

Elliot Price: Yep, send me exact mins and I’ll add a small “Requires SDK >= X” line next to code blocks.

Wei Chen: Also: can we explicitly say “don’t parse tool args until `tool_call.completed` (or final)”? That’s the thing users keep doing.

Ibrahim Khan: Yes. Wording we’ve been using: “Tool arguments may arrive as partial JSON across multiple deltas; accumulate as a string and parse only once complete.”

Connor O'Brien: :thumbsup: that’s going into the release brief.

ReleaseBot: :bell: Reminder — "SDK+docs examples refresh release checklist" due now

Sabrina James: Monica approved redwood-examples safety notes (just got :thumbsup: in PR). I’ll merge 145/147 once CI finishes.

Monica Patel: Confirmed.

Connor O'Brien: Great. Action items:
- Sabrina: merge redwood-examples once green
- Elliot: prep docs merges (901-904) and confirm deploy plan
- Dana/Mateusz/Ibrahim: final version bumps + changelog lines
- Sahana: be on point for staging snippet run + post results

Connor O'Brien: I’ll create a short go/no-go thread here on Wed morning and we’ll call it when staging smoke is green + docs deployed.

Elliot Price: +1.

Dana Lo: +1.

Mateusz Zielinski: +1.

Sahana Iyer: +1.

Ibrahim Khan: +1.
